recommendation: Store BH1750 output exclusively as auxiliary lux telemetry. Plant-light evaluation is enabled only for fixed-spectrum, daylight-excluded intervals after the exact BH1750–luminaire combination passes a co-located quantum-sensor validation; mixed/daylit intervals remain metrologically blocked.
why: All five verified crop-light records use PPFD or DLI; q001 quarantines universal lux as unit_not_transferable.
A coefficient is valid only for the exact BH1750, fixed spectrum, operating range, and validated geometry.
Mixed daylight changes spectrum, so total lux cannot recover photon flux or full-day DLI.
This is metrology-blocked, unlike noise's missing legal site classification.

-- The three JSON documents are loaded byte-for-byte as evidence payloads.
CREATE TABLE evidence_document (
  document_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (document_name IN (
    'verified_numeric_evidence','insufficient_evidence','collection_contract'
  )),
  schema_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(sha256)=64),
  payload_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(payload_json))
) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TRIGGER evidence_document_no_update
BEFORE UPDATE ON evidence_document BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'evidence documents are immutable');
END;
CREATE TRIGGER evidence_document_no_delete
BEFORE DELETE ON evidence_document BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'evidence documents are immutable');
END;

-- Metric-specific typed projections: no generic value or unit column exists.
CREATE TABLE corpus_ppfd_reference (
  record_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_document TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'verified_numeric_evidence'
    CHECK (source_document='verified_numeric_evidence'),
  crop TEXT NOT NULL,
  claim_role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (claim_role IN (
    'author_recommended_target','comparative_best_tested_point',
    'comparative_suitable_band'
  )),
  point_ppfd_umol_m2_s REAL,
  band_low_ppfd_umol_m2_s REAL,
  band_high_ppfd_umol_m2_s REAL,
  tested_low_ppfd_umol_m2_s REAL NOT NULL,
  tested_high_ppfd_umol_m2_s REAL NOT NULL,
  photoperiod_h REAL NOT NULL CHECK (photoperiod_h>0 AND photoperiod_h<=24),
  context_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  prohibited_use TEXT NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (source_document) REFERENCES evidence_document(document_name),
  CHECK (record_id<>'all-crops-universal-lux-threshold-q001'),
  CHECK (tested_low_ppfd_umol_m2_s<=tested_high_ppfd_umol_m2_s),
  CHECK (
    (claim_role='comparative_suitable_band' AND
     point_ppfd_umol_m2_s IS NULL AND
     band_low_ppfd_umol_m2_s IS NOT NULL AND
     band_high_ppfd_umol_m2_s IS NOT NULL AND
     tested_low_ppfd_umol_m2_s<=band_low_ppfd_umol_m2_s AND
     band_low_ppfd_umol_m2_s<=band_high_ppfd_umol_m2_s AND
     band_high_ppfd_umol_m2_s<=tested_high_ppfd_umol_m2_s)
    OR
    (claim_role IN ('author_recommended_target','comparative_best_tested_point') AND
     point_ppfd_umol_m2_s IS NOT NULL AND
     band_low_ppfd_umol_m2_s IS NULL AND
     band_high_ppfd_umol_m2_s IS NULL AND
     point_ppfd_umol_m2_s BETWEEN tested_low_ppfd_umol_m2_s
                              AND tested_high_ppfd_umol_m2_s)
  )
) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE corpus_dli_reference (
  record_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_document TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'verified_numeric_evidence'
    CHECK (source_document='verified_numeric_evidence'),
  crop TEXT NOT NULL,
  claim_role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (claim_role='author_recommended_target'),
  point_dli_mol_m2_day REAL NOT NULL CHECK (point_dli_mol_m2_day>=0),
  tested_low_dli_mol_m2_day REAL NOT NULL,
  tested_high_dli_mol_m2_day REAL NOT NULL,
  context_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  prohibited_use TEXT NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (source_document) REFERENCES evidence_document(document_name),
  CHECK (record_id<>'all-crops-universal-lux-threshold-q001'),
  CHECK (tested_low_dli_mol_m2_day<=point_dli_mol_m2_day AND
         point_dli_mol_m2_day<=tested_high_dli_mol_m2_day)
) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE zone (
  zone_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  site_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  timezone TEXT NOT NULL,
  indoor_or_outdoor TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (indoor_or_outdoor IN ('indoor','outdoor'))
) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE bh1750_sensor (
  sensor_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  sensor_model TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (instr(upper(sensor_model),'BH1750')>0),
  asset_or_serial_number TEXT NOT NULL,
  firmware_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  verification_date TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE quantum_reference_instrument (
  instrument_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  model TEXT NOT NULL,
  serial_number TEXT NOT NULL,
  calibration_certificate_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  calibration_valid_through TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE light_regime (
  regime_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  zone_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  spectrum_mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (spectrum_mode IN (
    'fixed_artificial','mixed_daylight_artificial','variable_or_unknown'
  )),
  daylight_excluded INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (daylight_excluded IN (0,1)),
  source_fingerprint TEXT,
  spectrum_fingerprint TEXT,
  fixed_spectrum_eligible INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS (
    CASE WHEN spectrum_mode='fixed_artificial' AND daylight_excluded=1
         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  ) STORED,
  FOREIGN KEY (zone_id) REFERENCES zone(zone_id),
  UNIQUE (regime_id,zone_id),
  UNIQUE (regime_id,fixed_spectrum_eligible),
  CHECK (spectrum_mode<>'mixed_daylight_artificial' OR daylight_excluded=0),
  CHECK (spectrum_mode<>'fixed_artificial' OR
         (daylight_excluded=1 AND source_fingerprint IS NOT NULL
          AND spectrum_fingerprint IS NOT NULL))
) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID;

-- A validation row cannot even reference a mixed/variable regime: the composite
-- FK requires fixed_spectrum_eligible=1.
CREATE TABLE lux_ppfd_validation (
  validation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  regime_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  required_regime_eligibility INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
    CHECK (required_regime_eligibility=1),
  lux_sensor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  quantum_instrument_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('draft','accepted','rejected')),
  ppfd_per_lux REAL NOT NULL CHECK (ppfd_per_lux>0),
  ppfd_intercept REAL NOT NULL,
  valid_lux_min REAL NOT NULL CHECK (valid_lux_min>=0),
  valid_lux_max REAL NOT NULL CHECK (valid_lux_max>valid_lux_min),
  paired_sample_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (paired_sample_count>0),
  spatial_position_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (spatial_position_count>0),
  operating_level_count INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (operating_level_count>0),
  validation_rmse_ppfd REAL NOT NULL CHECK (validation_rmse_ppfd>=0),
  validation_max_abs_error_ppfd REAL NOT NULL
    CHECK (validation_max_abs_error_ppfd>=0),
  acceptance_max_abs_error_ppfd REAL NOT NULL
    CHECK (acceptance_max_abs_error_ppfd>0),
  valid_from_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
  valid_to_utc TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY (regime_id,required_regime_eligibility)
    REFERENCES light_regime(regime_id,fixed_spectrum_eligible),
  FOREIGN KEY (lux_sensor_id) REFERENCES bh1750_sensor(sensor_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (quantum_instrument_id)
    REFERENCES quantum_reference_instrument(instrument_id),
  UNIQUE (validation_id,lux_sensor_id,regime_id,status),
  CHECK (valid_to_utc IS NULL OR valid_to_utc>valid_from_utc),
  CHECK (status<>'accepted' OR
    (validation_max_abs_error_ppfd<=acceptance_max_abs_error_ppfd AND
     paired_sample_count>=spatial_position_count*operating_level_count))
) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID;

-- These are field-validation pairs, not corpus references.
CREATE TABLE lux_ppfd_validation_pair (
  validation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  pair_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
  captured_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
  position_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  operating_level_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  bh1750_lx REAL NOT NULL CHECK (bh1750_lx>=0),
  reference_ppfd_umol_m2_s REAL NOT NULL CHECK (reference_ppfd_umol_m2_s>=0),
  PRIMARY KEY (validation_id,pair_number),
  FOREIGN KEY (validation_id) REFERENCES lux_ppfd_validation(validation_id)
) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TRIGGER validation_no_direct_accept
BEFORE INSERT ON lux_ppfd_validation
WHEN NEW.status='accepted' BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'insert draft, load paired field samples, then accept');
END;

CREATE TRIGGER validation_accept_guard
BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON lux_ppfd_validation
WHEN NEW.status='accepted' BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN OLD.status<>'draft' THEN
    RAISE(ABORT,'only a draft validation can be accepted') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN
    (SELECT count(*) FROM lux_ppfd_validation_pair
      WHERE validation_id=NEW.validation_id)<>NEW.paired_sample_count
    THEN RAISE(ABORT,'paired sample count mismatch') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN
    (SELECT count(DISTINCT position_key) FROM lux_ppfd_validation_pair
      WHERE validation_id=NEW.validation_id)<NEW.spatial_position_count
    THEN RAISE(ABORT,'spatial grid not demonstrated') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN
    (SELECT count(DISTINCT operating_level_key) FROM lux_ppfd_validation_pair
      WHERE validation_id=NEW.validation_id)<NEW.operating_level_count
    THEN RAISE(ABORT,'operating range not demonstrated') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN
    (SELECT min(bh1750_lx) FROM lux_ppfd_validation_pair
      WHERE validation_id=NEW.validation_id)>NEW.valid_lux_min OR
    (SELECT max(bh1750_lx) FROM lux_ppfd_validation_pair
      WHERE validation_id=NEW.validation_id)<NEW.valid_lux_max
    THEN RAISE(ABORT,'declared lux range exceeds sampled range') END;
END;

-- Lux-native operational telemetry. Unit is encoded in the column name; there is
-- deliberately no generic raw_value, unit, PPFD, DLI, crop boundary, or evidence FK.
CREATE TABLE raw_lux_observation (
  lux_observation_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  sensor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  regime_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  zone_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  captured_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (substr(captured_at_utc,-1)='Z'),
  local_day TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(local_day)=10),
  integration_seconds REAL NOT NULL CHECK (integration_seconds>0),
  measurement_height_m REAL NOT NULL CHECK (measurement_height_m>=0),
  illuminance_lx REAL NOT NULL CHECK (illuminance_lx>=0 AND illuminance_lx<=65535),
  quality_flag TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (quality_flag IN ('ok','suspect','saturated')),
  FOREIGN KEY (sensor_id) REFERENCES bh1750_sensor(sensor_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (regime_id,zone_id) REFERENCES light_regime(regime_id,zone_id),
  UNIQUE (sensor_id,captured_at_utc),
  UNIQUE (lux_observation_id,sensor_id,regime_id),
  CHECK ((quality_flag='saturated' AND illuminance_lx=65535) OR
         (quality_flag IN ('ok','suspect') AND illuminance_lx<65535))
) STRICT;

-- Only an accepted profile for the same physical sensor and regime can be assigned.
CREATE TABLE lux_conversion_assignment (
  lux_observation_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  sensor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  regime_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  validation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  required_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'accepted' CHECK (required_status='accepted'),
  FOREIGN KEY (lux_observation_id,sensor_id,regime_id)
    REFERENCES raw_lux_observation(lux_observation_id,sensor_id,regime_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (validation_id,sensor_id,regime_id,required_status)
    REFERENCES lux_ppfd_validation(validation_id,lux_sensor_id,regime_id,status)
) STRICT;

-- This is the sole plant-measurement input exposed to PPFD/DLI evaluation.
-- It exposes derived PPFD and uncertainty, never illuminance_lx.
CREATE VIEW derived_ppfd_observation AS
SELECT l.sensor_id,l.zone_id,l.regime_id,l.captured_at_utc,l.local_day,
       l.integration_seconds,a.validation_id,
       max(0.0,v.ppfd_per_lux*l.illuminance_lx+v.ppfd_intercept)
         AS ppfd_estimate_umol_m2_s,
       max(0.0,max(0.0,v.ppfd_per_lux*l.illuminance_lx+v.ppfd_intercept)
                   -v.validation_max_abs_error_ppfd)
         AS ppfd_lower_umol_m2_s,
       max(0.0,v.ppfd_per_lux*l.illuminance_lx+v.ppfd_intercept)
                   +v.validation_max_abs_error_ppfd
         AS ppfd_upper_umol_m2_s
FROM raw_lux_observation AS l
JOIN lux_conversion_assignment AS a USING (lux_observation_id)
JOIN lux_ppfd_validation AS v ON v.validation_id=a.validation_id
WHERE l.quality_flag='ok'
  AND l.illuminance_lx BETWEEN v.valid_lux_min AND v.valid_lux_max
  AND l.captured_at_utc>=v.valid_from_utc
  AND (v.valid_to_utc IS NULL OR l.captured_at_utc<v.valid_to_utc);

CREATE VIEW derived_dli_day AS
SELECT sensor_id,zone_id,local_day,
       sum(ppfd_estimate_umol_m2_s*integration_seconds)/1000000.0
         AS dli_estimate_mol_m2_day,
       sum(ppfd_lower_umol_m2_s*integration_seconds)/1000000.0
         AS dli_lower_mol_m2_day,
       sum(ppfd_upper_umol_m2_s*integration_seconds)/1000000.0
         AS dli_upper_mol_m2_day,
       sum(integration_seconds) AS covered_seconds
FROM derived_ppfd_observation
GROUP BY sensor_id,zone_id,local_day;

-- Default-deny deployment context and role-specific admission.
CREATE TABLE crop_light_context (
  context_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  zone_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  crop TEXT NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE admitted_ppfd_reference (
  context_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  record_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  objective_match INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (objective_match=1),
  cultivar_stage_match INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (cultivar_stage_match=1),
  environment_match INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (environment_match=1),
  measurement_basis_match INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (measurement_basis_match=1),
  temporal_window_match INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (temporal_window_match=1),
  reviewed_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  reviewed_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (context_id,record_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (context_id) REFERENCES crop_light_context(context_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (record_id) REFERENCES corpus_ppfd_reference(record_id)

CREATE TABLE admitted_dli_reference (
  context_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  record_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  objective_match INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (objective_match=1),
  cultivar_stage_match INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (cultivar_stage_match=1),
  environment_match INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (environment_match=1),
  measurement_basis_match INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (measurement_basis_match=1),
  temporal_window_match INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (temporal_window_match=1),
  reviewed_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  reviewed_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (context_id,record_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (context_id) REFERENCES crop_light_context(context_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (record_id) REFERENCES corpus_dli_reference(record_id)

-- DLI comparison remains absent until a completeness policy reviews the day.
CREATE TABLE admitted_dli_day (
  sensor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  local_day TEXT NOT NULL,
  temporal_window_complete INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (temporal_window_complete=1),
  reviewed_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (sensor_id,local_day),
  FOREIGN KEY (sensor_id) REFERENCES bh1750_sensor(sensor_id)
) STRICT, WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE VIEW ppfd_reference_indicator AS
SELECT c.context_id,d.captured_at_utc,r.record_id,r.claim_role,
       d.ppfd_estimate_umol_m2_s,d.ppfd_lower_umol_m2_s,d.ppfd_upper_umol_m2_s,
       CASE WHEN d.ppfd_estimate_umol_m2_s NOT BETWEEN
                      r.tested_low_ppfd_umol_m2_s AND r.tested_high_ppfd_umol_m2_s
            THEN 'unknown_outside_tested_grid'
            ELSE 'distance_only' END AS indicator_state,
       CASE WHEN d.ppfd_estimate_umol_m2_s NOT BETWEEN
                      r.tested_low_ppfd_umol_m2_s AND r.tested_high_ppfd_umol_m2_s
            THEN NULL
            WHEN r.point_ppfd_umol_m2_s IS NOT NULL
            THEN d.ppfd_estimate_umol_m2_s-r.point_ppfd_umol_m2_s
            WHEN d.ppfd_estimate_umol_m2_s<r.band_low_ppfd_umol_m2_s
            THEN d.ppfd_estimate_umol_m2_s-r.band_low_ppfd_umol_m2_s
            WHEN d.ppfd_estimate_umol_m2_s>r.band_high_ppfd_umol_m2_s
            THEN d.ppfd_estimate_umol_m2_s-r.band_high_ppfd_umol_m2_s
            ELSE 0 END AS distance_ppfd_umol_m2_s
FROM derived_ppfd_observation AS d
JOIN crop_light_context AS c ON c.zone_id=d.zone_id
 AND d.captured_at_utc>=c.valid_from_utc
 AND (c.valid_to_utc IS NULL OR d.captured_at_utc<c.valid_to_utc)
JOIN admitted_ppfd_reference AS a ON a.context_id=c.context_id
JOIN corpus_ppfd_reference AS r ON r.record_id=a.record_id AND r.crop=c.crop;

CREATE VIEW dli_reference_indicator AS
SELECT c.context_id,d.local_day,r.record_id,r.claim_role,
       d.dli_estimate_mol_m2_day,d.dli_lower_mol_m2_day,d.dli_upper_mol_m2_day,
       CASE WHEN d.dli_estimate_mol_m2_day NOT BETWEEN
                      r.tested_low_dli_mol_m2_day AND r.tested_high_dli_mol_m2_day
            THEN 'unknown_outside_tested_grid'
            ELSE 'distance_only' END AS indicator_state,
       CASE WHEN d.dli_estimate_mol_m2_day BETWEEN
                      r.tested_low_dli_mol_m2_day AND r.tested_high_dli_mol_m2_day
            THEN d.dli_estimate_mol_m2_day-r.point_dli_mol_m2_day
            ELSE NULL END AS distance_dli_mol_m2_day
FROM derived_dli_day AS d
JOIN admitted_dli_day AS day_gate USING (sensor_id,local_day)
JOIN crop_light_context AS c ON c.zone_id=d.zone_id
JOIN admitted_dli_reference AS a ON a.context_id=c.context_id
JOIN corpus_dli_reference AS r ON r.record_id=a.record_id AND r.crop=c.crop;

CREATE VIEW plant_light_metrology_state AS
SELECT r.regime_id,r.zone_id,
 CASE
  WHEN r.fixed_spectrum_eligible=0 THEN 'blocked_variable_spectrum'
  WHEN NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM lux_ppfd_validation v
    WHERE v.regime_id=r.regime_id AND v.status='accepted'
  ) THEN 'blocked_conversion_unvalidated'
  ELSE 'derived_metric_available_context_gate_required'
 END AS state
FROM light_regime AS r;

CREATE VIEW operator_lux_channel AS
SELECT zone_id,captured_at_utc,illuminance_lx,quality_flag,
       'auxiliary_non_scoring' AS channel_role
FROM raw_lux_observation;

-- Enforcement map:
-- 1. raw_lux_observation has no PPFD/DLI/reference/value/unit columns.
-- 2. PPFD and DLI corpus projections are separate typed tables.
-- 3. q001 cannot enter either typed projection.
-- 4. A mixed/daylit regime cannot satisfy the validation composite FK.
-- 5. Evaluation views consume derived_ppfd_observation/derived_dli_day only.
-- 6. Absence from admitted_* tables means blocked by default.
-- 7. Tested-domain checks return unknown; they never extrapolate danger/quality.
-- SQLite DDL cannot prevent a privileged arbitrary cross-join of base tables;
-- hostile-query isolation additionally requires an SQLite authorizer or separate
-- evaluator connection exposing only the admitted views.

plant_light_verdict.what_the_operator_sees: Always: timestamped lux, quality/saturation, human-visual illuminance, and on/off or relative change under one unchanged source. While blocked: an explicit variable-spectrum or unvalidated-conversion message and no crop-light status. After validation: estimated PPFD/DLI with profile, uncertainty, validity range, and context-gated distance indicators.
plant_light_verdict.what_dies: Universal lux crop thresholds, direct raw-lux comparison with 500/150–200/140/200 PPFD or 11.5 DLI, and whole-day crop-light evaluation in a daylit mixed-spectrum space.

assumptions: SQLite 3.37+ with STRICT/JSON1 and foreign_keys enabled on every connection.
Evidence remains default-deny until all context and temporal attestations exist.
risks: LED aging, temperature, dimming, optics, sensor replacement, or sunlight leaks invalidate a profile.
BH1750 error or saturation can make estimated distances too uncertain for action.
DDL cannot stop privileged ad-hoc cross-joins; hostile-query isolation needs an authorizer or separate connection.
cheap_validation: Run one in-memory SQLite negative-path smoke test: load the DDL, declare a mixed-daylight regime, and assert that validation/assignment fails and that no PPFD/DLI indicator row can be produced from its raw lux observation.
change_mind_if: The actual zone is proven daylight-free and a co-located calibrated quantum-sensor campaign—covering darkness, every used dimming setting, and the canopy grid—meets a predeclared error tolerance. A single paired reading is insufficient; any sensor, luminaire, spectrum, optics, or daylight condition change requires revalidation.
